name: Carlin

attributes.attribute: title for the Cailleach in Scotland

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Carlin is a heroine or goddess of Scotland. There the term was used as a title for the Cailleach in her role as a harvest divinity.

okr.objective: Carlin is a Scottish name for the harvest goddess Cailleach.
key_results: Scottish tradition calls her a heroine or goddess.
In Scotland the name titles the Cailleach.
She acted as a harvest divinity.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
